integrity: A self-contained character calculation and a standalone exact rational/integer checker are provided. All formulas are conditional only on the standard explicitly described binary-octahedral and S4 structure. Independent mathematical validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Exact degree 12; two deleted antipodal classes of the 24-point binary-octahedral quotient; determinant-optimality only. No higher-deletion, other-degree, or condition-number optimality assertion. Historical equivalence under association-scheme methods remains a risk.
title: Pair-erasure D-optimal harmonic sampling on the binary octahedral configuration
